title: How does construction impact Brookline’s Town finances?
description: Construction is great for our Town’s finances and reduces future taxes for existing property owners. Increasing construction-based property tax growth from 1.3% to 2.1% per year would have arguably avoided all overrides for the past 20 years.

title: Brookline property tax overview
description: With the property tax override on the May 5th 2026 ballot I became curious about how property taxes work here in Brookline. I've also found that most discussions about property taxes ignore the impact of new property growth from renovation and new development.
